$comment: Dated aliases of sf-tree-item for the shim (stands/18-aliases-ci/alias.mjs, standard §16 item 20). mode: same-detail (the shim sends the new and the old name), split / detail-adds (a detail adapter, refused by the shim), attribute-and-property, method, property, manifest-only (the DOM name does not change), host-attribute (no shim), retired.

aliases.note: one name for the node's name; label wins when both are given
the legacy axis name; the shim maps the attribute and the property
the old detail {item, value, originalEvent} is made by the element's adapter
the manifest declares the verb; the DOM name is unchanged, so the shim has nothing to send
